body.condition: For every comparison \(k\in[K]\), the pooled selected law \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}(dx,dz)=\tfrac12P_{\eta}^{(0)}(dx)\delta_0(dz)+\tfrac12P_{\eta}^{(k)}(dx)\delta_1(dz)\) on \(X\cup\{\zeta_k\}\) is faithful to \(M_k(\eta)\): for every disjoint vertex sets \(R_1,R_2,W\subseteq U_k\), \(X_{R_1}\mathbin{\perp\!\!\!\perp}X_{R_2}\mid X_W\) under \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\) if and only if \(R_1\) and \(R_2\) are \(m\)-separated by \(W\) in \(M_k(\eta)\), with \(X_{\zeta_k}:=\zeta_k\).
